name: io.github.zapxlabs/veyra
title: Veyra
description: Give AI agents a wallet with a spending limit. Non-custodial USDC on Base, server-enforced limits.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <endpoint credential>. Create one at https://veyra.money/dashboard; it starts with veyra_.
